Q010973: fixed: distractor said late records are 'processed by the join' while the stem query is a union of two streams; wording now 'by the query', G cites the Spark guide's 'use judiciously' note (f03) https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/streaming/apis-on-dataframes-and-datasets.html
Q010978: fixed: explanation offered 'an AvailableNow run with endingOffsets in a batch read'; endingOffsets is a batch-query-only Kafka option, so the backfill is either a streaming query with its own checkpoint and availableNow or a spark.read with startingOffsets/endingOffsets (e02) https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/streaming/structured-streaming-kafka-integration.html
